task: normalized useChapterPlayback's playback queue to block-leader ids, fixing manual Prev/Next mid-block bug

frontend/src/hooks/useChapterPlayback.ts.summary: playSegment now normalizes the incoming raw per-segment fullQueue to one entry per block (buildBlockQueue, using getGroupSegmentIds as the sole block-membership source) before storing it in playbackQueueRef; a request to play a non-leader block member resolves to the block's leader id as the starting index. Deleted the separate onEnded audio_file_path-equality skip-ahead walk (now dead code against a block-leader queue) in favor of a direct playFromIndex(idx + 1, queue) call. onPrev now restarts the current block on first press and only steps back a block when playback position is within 1.0s of the block start (owner-confirmed restart-first semantics). hasPrev/hasNext are unchanged in shape but now correctly reflect block-queue position since the queue itself is block-normalized. Added a blockMembersRef (leaderId -> full member ids) populated once per playSegment call so playFromIndex's playingSegmentIds highlighting and missing-audio detection still see full block membership even though the navigation queue itself only holds leader ids. playSegment's exported call signature ((segmentId: string, fullQueue: string[]) => Promise<void>) is unchanged; useStudioChapter.ts and playerBus.ts were not touched (INV-4 holds).

flow_impact: global PlayerBar Prev/Next now correctly navigates between distinct audio blocks instead of restarting mid-block clips
